project_type: Modular Arduino sketch (C/C++) for uKit Explore 2 board
test_framework: No automated tests; verification by compile in Arduino IDE
build_command: cd LineFollowerFin && arduino-cli compile --fqbn arduino:avr:mega LineFollowerFin.ino
verification_instructions:
1. Ensure uKitExplore2 library is installed in ~/Arduino/libraries/
2. Run: arduino-cli compile --fqbn arduino:avr:mega LineFollowerFin.ino
3. Confirm no compile errors (Sketch uses X bytes, Global variables use Y bytes)
setup_instructions:
1. Install arduino-cli
2. Install AVR core: arduino-cli core install arduino:avr
3. Install uKitExplore2 library in ~/Arduino/libraries/
4. Copy library to LineFollowerFin/lib/ if needed
environment_constraints: Target is ATMega2560 (8KB RAM). Optional features default OFF because of RAM/complexity. Use #if guards (ENABLE_BLUETOOTH, ENABLE_PATH_PLANNER, ENABLE_LAP_TIMER).
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: .ino holds only objects, setup(), loop() state machine; logic in classes (one .h/.cpp pair). config.h for tunable values. status.h for shared Status struct. fwd.h forward declarations mandatory (eepromPutHemat template breaks auto-prototype). Indonesian comments/prints preserved. Motor mapping: servos 4+2 = left (dir 1), servos 1+3 = right (dir 0). Speed derated 0-150, deadband 25, slew limit 14/loop. Sensor: readInfraredDistance(2)=left, (1)=right, error=(kiri-kanan)/2. EEPROM layout: addr 0=magic 123, 4=Kp float, 8=Ki float, 12=Kd float, 16=kecepatanDasarMaks int, 20=AMBANG_KIRI int, 22=AMBANG_KANAN int, 24=MAP data.
key_patterns: Optional features use #if ENABLE_X guards and are registered in .ino with #if/#endif. bluetooth_ctrl.h/.cpp is the template to follow for new optional modules (constructor takes Status, Penggerak, SensorGaris, Pengaman, LapTimer refs). config.h uses #define for constants and extern for globals defined in config.cpp. status.h uses enum + struct. fwd.h lists forward class declarations. eepromPutHemat template must stay in sensor_garis.h. beep() declared in config.h, defined in config.cpp.
directory_structure: LineFollowerFin/ is the sketch folder (same name as .ino). Contains: .ino (entry), config.h/cpp (globals + beep), status.h (Status struct + ModeOperasi enum), fwd.h (forward decls), sensor_garis.h/cpp (IR filter, calibration, EEPROM), penggerak.h/cpp (PID, motor helpers), antarmuka.h/cpp (buttons, clap, serial parser), pengaman.h/cpp (battery, tilt, ultrasonic, stuck, headlight), mapping.h/cpp (learning/racing mapper), lap_timer.h/cpp (lap timer), bluetooth_ctrl.h/cpp (BT control), path_planner.h/cpp (A* planner), ukit_wrapper.h/ukit_macros.h/ukit_extern.h (uKit library wrappers), serial_silent.h (Serial dummy). tests/ contains TestBluetooth/, TestLapTimer/, TestPathPlanner/ test sketches.
